data.title: Coalition: Seven Legitimate Military Targets Supporting Houthi Military Efforts Destroyed
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that seven legitimate military targets designated for military use in support of the Houthi militia's military efforts have been destroyed, as well as six workshops used for manufacturing and assembling ballistic missile launcher structures and UAVs.
    Al-Malki further indicated that one of the terrorist Houthi militia's primary supply depots in Sanaa has been neutralized.
    -- SPA
17:40 Local Time 14:40 GMT
